hook.convey: one whole stretch from start = 0 to finish = 1; stopping exactly halfway → standing on a real spot → 0 and 1 have no name for it → there are numbers between 0 and 1 too, and fractions name them

use.hi: Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai.
use.en: A cricket pitch: one stump at 0, the other at 1. The batsman stopped right in the middle; that spot has a number too.

use.hi: Ghar 0 par, school 1 kilometre par; school bus aadhe raaste mein ruki. Us jagah ka bhi number hota hai.
use.en: Home is at 0, school at 1 kilometre; the school bus stopped halfway. That spot has a number too.

use.hi: Game mein level ki progress 0 se 1 tak bharti hai; abhi aadhi bhari hai, beech ke ek number par.
use.en: In a game the level's progress fills from 0 to 1; right now it is half full, at a number in between.

explain.convey: 0 and 1 at the ends; one cut exactly in the middle → 2 equal gaps; the middle mark = 1/2 → 1/2 is a number with its own place, between 0 and 1, not at 2

viewCaption.hi: Yahan line ki jagah ek patti hai, do barabar gaps mein, aur ek gap rangin hai. Rangin gap patti ke shuru se theek beech tak jaata hai, jaise line par 0 se beech wale mark tak.
viewCaption.en: Here, in place of the line, there is a strip in two equal gaps, with one gap coloured. The coloured gap runs from the start of the strip to exactly the middle, like 0 to the middle mark on the line.

point.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 ki line hai. Beech ke mark se 2 barabar gaps bane; is mark ka naam 1/2 hai.
point.en: This is the line from 0 to 1. The mark in the middle makes 2 equal gaps; this mark is called 1/2.

pointAlt.hi: Ek roti ko theek beech se kaato toh do barabar hisse milte hain. Line par bhi beech wala mark 0 se 1 ko aise hi do barabar gaps mein baant-ta hai, isliye woh 1/2 hai.
pointAlt.en: Cut a roti right down the middle and you get two equal parts. The middle mark on the line splits 0 to 1 the same way, into two equal gaps, so it is 1/2.

prompt.hi: Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: Now the line is also cut into 3 equal gaps. Which fraction is the first mark after 0 there?

hindi.hi: Ab 3 gap bhi bane hain. 0 se chala pehla gap jahan khatam hota hai, us mark ka naam batao, kis fraction ka hai?
hindi.en: Now there are 3 gaps too. Where the first gap from 0 ends, tell me that mark's name: which fraction is it?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: If the line from 0 to 1 is cut into 3 equal gaps, which fraction is the first mark after 0?

why.hi: Tumne 1/2 bataya, jo 2 barabar gaps wala mark hai. 3 gaps wali line par pehle mark ka naam un 3 gaps se banao.
why.en: You said 1/2, the mark of the 2 equal gaps. On the line of 3 gaps, name the first mark from those 3 gaps.

simpler.hi: Beech wale mark ka naam line ke 2 barabar gaps se aaya tha. Ab 3 gaps wale marks dekho, aur pehle mark ka naam usi tarah rakho.
simpler.en: The middle mark got its name from the line's 2 equal gaps. Now count the gaps on the other side, and name the first mark the same way.

why.hi: 3 barabar gaps mein pehla mark pehle gap ke ant par aata hai, isliye uska naam 1/3 hai, 3 nahi
why.en: in 3 equal gaps the first mark comes at the end of the first gap, so its name is 1/3, not 3

whyShort.hi: 3 gaps mein se ek gap tak: 1/3
whyShort.en: one gap of the 3: 1/3

whyAlt.hi: 3 toh gaps ki ginti hai, mark ka naam nahi; mark ke naam mein dono baatein aati hain: 0 se kitne gap chale, aur 0 se 1 tak kitne gap hain
whyAlt.en: 3 is the number of gaps, not the mark's name; a mark's name holds both things: how many gaps from 0, and how many gaps from 0 to 1

viewCaption.hi: Yahan line ki dono taraf barabar lambi pattiyan hain: ek taraf ki patti do barabar gaps mein, ek gap rangin, aur doosri taraf ki patti teen barabar gaps mein, abhi bina rang ke.
viewCaption.en: Here are strips of the same length on both sides of the line: one side in two equal gaps with one coloured, and the other side in three equal gaps, not coloured yet.

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti ka pehla gap ab rangin hai. Woh gap jahan khatam hota hai, wahi 1/3 hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech.
answerViewCaption.en: The other side's first gap is now coloured. Where that gap ends is 1/3, between 0 and 1.

simpler.hi: 0 se beech wale mark tak ek gap, aur wahan se 1 tak ek aur: dono gap ek jitne lambe. Do mein se pehla gap, isliye 1/2.
simpler.en: From 0 to the middle mark is one gap, and from there to 1 another: both gaps the same length. The first of two gaps, so 1/2.

explain.convey: same 0 to 1, now 6 marks inside → 7 equal gaps (gaps = marks inside + 1); bottom number = number of equal gaps in 0 to 1; first mark from 0 = end of 1 gap = 1/7; the name comes from gaps, not marks

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti saat barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai, 1/7. Line par chhe marks the, par gaps saat.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in seven equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured, 1/7. The line had six marks, but seven gaps.

point.hi: Ab 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain. Neeche wala number gaps se aata hai: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/7 hai.
point.en: Now there are 6 marks between 0 and 1. The bottom number comes from the gaps: 7 equal gaps. So the first mark after 0 is 1/7.

pointAlt.hi: 0 se chalo: har mark se pehle ek gap aata hai, toh 6 marks ke 6 gaps, aur aakhri mark ke baad 1 tak ek gap aur. Isliye 6 marks ke saath 7 gaps hain, aur 0 ke baad wala pehla mark 1/7 hai.
pointAlt.en: Walk from 0: there is a gap before each mark, so 6 marks give 6 gaps, and one more gap after the last mark up to 1. That's why 6 marks come with 7 gaps, and the first mark after 0 is 1/7.

prompt.hi: Ab socho, ek aur line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Wahan kitne gaps banenge?
prompt.en: Now think: on another line there are 7 marks between 0 and 1, which split it into equal gaps. How many gaps will it have?

reask.hi: 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks line ko barabar gaps mein baant-te hon, toh kitne gaps banenge?

whyShort.hi: marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps

simpler.en: The line had 6 marks and 7 gaps. Gaps are between the marks and also at both ends, so there is always one more gap than marks.

explain.convey: the same 0 to 1 in 8 equal gaps → more gaps than the 7 before → each gap smaller; 1/8 = first mark, right next to 0; 1/2 still the middle mark (4 of the 8 gaps); more equal gaps in the same whole → each gap shorter → 1/8 sits closer to 0 than 1/7 and 1/2

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti aath barabar gaps mein hai, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai, 1/8.

point.hi: Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door.
point.en: Now the same 0 to 1, but the line has 8 equal gaps. More gaps, so each gap is smaller than before. The first mark is 1/8, one gap from 0.

pointAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi roti socho: ek 4 barabar hisson mein kati, ek 6 mein, toh 6 wali ka har hissa patla hai. Line par bhi gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota, aur pehla mark utna hi 0 ke paas.
pointAlt.en: Think of two identical rotis: one cut into 4 equal parts, one into 6, so each part of the 6 one is thinner. On a line too, the more gaps, the shorter each gap, and the closer the first mark is to 0.

why.en: the more gaps, the smaller each gap: with 10 gaps the first mark, 1/10, comes nearer 0

whyShort.hi: zyada gaps, chhote gap: 1/10 0 ke paas
whyShort.en: more gaps, smaller gaps: 1/10 is nearer 0

whyAlt.hi: 8 ko 10 se chhota number dekhkar chuna hai; par yahan dekhna hai ki kiska ek gap chhota hai, aur 0 se 1 ko jitne zyada gaps mein kaato, har gap utna chhota
whyAlt.en: you picked 8 because it is a smaller number than 10; but here what matters is whose one gap is smaller, and the more gaps 0 to 1 is cut into, the smaller each gap

why.hi: 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11
why.en: 10 marks make 11 equal gaps, and the first mark is one gap along, at 1/11

whyShort.hi: 10 marks se 11 gaps, pehla mark ek gap par
whyShort.en: 10 marks make 11 gaps; the first is one gap

whyAlt.hi: 1/10 tab hota jab 0 se 1 ki line 10 barabar gaps mein hoti; par yahan 10 marks hain, aur 0 ke baad aur 1 se pehle bhi ek-ek gap hai
whyAlt.en: 1/10 would be right if the line from 0 to 1 were in 10 equal gaps; but here there are 10 marks, and there is one gap after 0 and one before 1 as well

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 11 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai: yahi 1/11 hai. Line ke 10 marks ne hi ise 11 gaps mein baanta tha.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 11 equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured: that is 1/11. The line's 10 marks are what cut it into 11 gaps.

simpler.hi: Neeche wala number marks nahi, gaps ginta hai. 0 aur 1 ke beech ke 10 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai.
simpler.en: The bottom number counts gaps, not marks. However many gaps the 10 marks between 0 and 1 make, that's the bottom number.

prompt.hi: Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: The line is cut once into 4 equal gaps, once into 12. Of their marks, which fraction is the mark nearest 0?

hindi.hi: Ek baar line ko 4 gap mein kaata, ek baar 12 mein. Inmein se jo mark 0 se sabse kam door hai, use kis fraction se bulayenge?
hindi.en: Once the line is cut into 4 gaps, once into 12. Of those, the mark least far from 0: what fraction do we call it?

reask.hi: 4 gaps aur 12 gaps ke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: Of the marks of 4 gaps and 12 gaps, which fraction is nearest 0?

did.hi: 0 ke sabse paas wala mark pehchaana

viewCaption.hi: Line ki dono taraf barabar lambi pattiyan hain, ek taraf ki patti chaar barabar gaps mein aur doosri barah mein. Dono taraf ka pehla gap, baayein kinaare se, dhyan se dekho.
viewCaption.en: There are strips of the same length on both sides of the line, one side in four equal gaps and the other in twelve. Look closely at the first gap of each side, from the left end.

why.hi: 12 barabar gaps ka har gap 4 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/12 wala pehla mark 0 ke sabse paas hai
why.en: each of 12 equal gaps is shorter than each of 4, so the first mark, 1/12, is nearest 0

whyShort.hi: 12 gaps wala gap chhota, toh 1/12 sabse paas
whyShort.en: a gap out of 12 is shorter: 1/12

whyAlt.hi: 4 chhota number hai, par 4 gaps wali taraf ka har gap lamba hai; board par dono taraf ka pehla gap saath rakhkar dekho, kaunsa pehle khatam hota hai
whyAlt.en: 4 is a small number, but each gap on the 4-gap side is long; on the board put the first gap of each side together and see which one ends first

answerViewCaption.hi: Ek taraf ki patti 4 gaps mein hai, doosri 12 mein, aur dono ka pehla gap rangin hai. 1/12 wala rangin gap chhota hai, isliye woh 0 ke sabse paas hai.
answerViewCaption.en: One side is in 4 gaps, the other in 12, and the first gap of each is coloured. The coloured 1/12 gap is shorter, so it is nearest 0.

simpler.hi: Bada number dekhkar mat chuno. Poori line ko jitne zyada barabar gaps mein kaato, har gap utna chhota hota hai.
simpler.en: Don't choose by the bigger number. The more equal gaps you cut the whole line into, the shorter each gap is.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
prompt.en: The line from 0 to 1 is in 9 equal gaps. Some people think 1/9 has no place on a line. Which mark after 0 is the place of 1/9?

reask.hi: 9 gaps wali line par 1/9 kaunsa mark hai?
reask.en: On the line of 9 gaps, which mark is 1/9?

did.hi: 9 gaps wali line par 1/9 ki jagah dhoondhi
did.en: found where 1/9 sits on a line of 9 gaps

viewCaption.hi: 0 se 1 tak ki line ab ek poori patti hai, nau barabar gaps mein kati hui. Patti ke 0 wale sire se gaps ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: The line from 0 to 1 is now one whole strip, cut into nine equal gaps. Look at the gaps one by one from the strip's 0 end.

why.hi: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai
why.en: 1/9 means 1 gap out of 9 equal gaps, so 1/9 sits one gap from 0, at the first mark

whyShort.hi: 1/9 matlab 0 se ek gap, yaani pehla mark
whyShort.en: 1/9 is one gap from 0, the first mark

whyAlt.hi: jaise 7 gaps wali line par 1/7 ki ek pakki jagah thi, waise hi 9 gaps wali line par 1/9 ki bhi jagah hai; 1/9 matlab 9 mein se 1 gap
whyAlt.en: just as 1/7 had a fixed spot on the line with 7 gaps, 1/9 has a spot on the line with 9 gaps; 1/9 means 1 gap out of 9

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 9 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai. Woh rangin gap jahan khatam hota hai, wahi line ka pehla mark hai, 1/9.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 9 equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured. Where that coloured gap ends is the line's first mark, 1/9.

simpler.hi: Socho, 1/9 kitne gaps ka naam hai, aur phir board par 0 se utne gaps gino.
simpler.en: Think how many gaps 1/9 is the name of, then count that many gaps from 0 on the board.

ladder.why: den 2: one cut, gaps obvious → fraction as a place on the road; same den as e1
den 4 (halves halved, as in the worked example) → 2nd mark = 2/4 → same spot as 1/2; gap-value thinking, not mark counting
den 5 given only as marks (4 inside) → must convert marks to gaps; error-spot on the count-marks trap
den 6 again but given as 5 inside marks → contrasts with rl-o1 (same den, gaps given) → explain why the label is wrong

remediation.move: ribbon at a tailor's shop, 0 to 1 m, the ribbon in 5 on the board; the cut in 12 is imagined (askWhole); marks = chalk marks, the ribbon between marks = gaps (never hisse); marks inside + 1 = gaps; a mark's name comes from counting gaps, not marks; 4 marks → 5 gaps → first mark at 1/5 m (not e2's 6 marks, 7 gaps); then imagined: first mark at 1/12 m → 12 gaps → 11 marks (the trap says 12)

say.hi: Darzi ka ribbon 0 se 1 metre tak hai, aur us par 4 chalk ke marks hain. Marks 4 hain, par gap 5 bante hain, isliye pehla mark 1/5 metre par hai.
say.en: The tailor's ribbon goes from 0 to 1 metre, and it has 4 chalk marks. There are 4 marks, but they make 5 gaps, so the first mark is at 1/5 metre.

simpler.hi: Ribbon par ungli 0 se 1 tak sarkao aur har gap par ek gino. Ginti chalk ke marks se ek zyada aati hai.
simpler.en: Slide your finger along the ribbon from 0 to 1 and count one for each gap. The count comes out one more than the chalk marks.

sayAlt.hi: Do deewaron ke beech kapde sukhane ki rassi par 4 clip socho: pehli deewar se pehle clip tak ek jagah, clipon ke beech 3, aur aakhri clip se deewar tak ek, kul 5. Chalk ke 4 marks bhi aise hi 5 gap banate hain.
sayAlt.en: Picture a clothesline between two walls with 4 pegs: one space from the first wall to the first peg, 3 between the pegs, and one from the last peg to the wall, 5 in all. The 4 chalk marks make 5 gaps the same way.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti darzi ka ribbon hai: paanch barabar gaps, aur pehla gap rangin, yaani 1/5 metre. Gaps ke beech ke marks hi chalk ke marks hain.
viewCaption.en: This strip is the tailor's ribbon: five equal gaps, and the first gap coloured, that is 1/5 metre. The marks between the gaps are the chalk marks.

prompt.hi: Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
prompt.en: Imagine cutting the same ribbon into 12 equal gaps. How many chalk marks go in between?

reask.hi: Socho, ek ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaatna hai: beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
reask.en: Imagine a ribbon has to be cut into 12 equal gaps: how many chalk marks go in between?

viewCaption.hi: Yeh darzi ka ribbon hai: paanch barabar gaps, pehla gap 1/5 metre. Ise 12 barabar gaps mein kaatne ke marks tumhe sochne hain.
viewCaption.en: This is the tailor's ribbon: five equal gaps, the first gap 1/5 metre. You have to imagine the marks for cutting it into 12 equal gaps.

why.hi: 12 barabar gaps ke beech 11 marks hote hain, gaps se ek kam
why.en: 12 equal gaps have 11 marks between them, one fewer than the gaps

whyShort.hi: 12 gap ke beech 11 marks hote hain
whyShort.en: 12 gaps have 11 marks between them

whyAlt.hi: Tumne gaps gine, par sawaal chalk ke marks ka hai. Marks gaps ke beech ke kinaare hain; ribbon ke dono sire khud 0 aur 1 hain.
whyAlt.en: You counted the gaps, but the question is about the chalk marks. Marks are the edges between gaps; the ribbon's two ends are 0 and 1 themselves.

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti 12 barabar gaps mein hai. Uske gaps ke beech 11 kinaare hain, aur wahi 11 chalk ke marks hain.
answerViewCaption.en: The other side is in 12 equal gaps. There are 11 edges between its gaps, and those are the 11 chalk marks.

simpler.hi: Ribbon par gaps aur chalk ke marks dono gino, aur dekho kaun kitna zyada hai. Phir wahi baat naye ribbon ke liye socho.
simpler.en: Count both the gaps and the chalk marks on the ribbon, and work out which is more, and by how much. Then think the same for the new ribbon.

remediation.move: on a board of halves (first row) and fifths (second row), naming none of the then-card's numbers: both lines are the same whole; a bigger bottom number shares the same whole into more gaps, so each gap is smaller → bigger bottom number = smaller gap; then, on the then-card's board (fifths in the first row, sevenths in the second, 1/5 marked), the child places 1/7: between 0 and 1/5, not after it

say.hi: Yahan 2 barabar gap bhi hain, aur 5 bhi. Gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota: 1/5 ka gap 1/2 wale se chhota.
say.en: Here there are 2 equal gaps, and 5 as well. The more gaps, the smaller each gap: the 1/5 gap is smaller than the 1/2 one.

viewCaption.hi: Yahan ek hi line ki dono taraf pattiyan hain: ek taraf ki patti do barabar gaps mein, doosri paanch mein, aur dono ka pehla gap rangin.
viewCaption.en: Here the one line has strips on both sides: one side in two equal gaps, the other in five, with the first gap of each coloured.

simpler.hi: Dono taraf ka pehla gap milao, aur dekho kaunsa chhota hai.
simpler.en: Compare the first gap on each side, and see which is shorter.

sayAlt.hi: Ek hi laddu socho: 2 bachchon mein baanto toh har ek ko bada hissa milta hai, 5 bachchon mein baanto toh chhota. Line par bhi aisa hi hai: 0 se 1 ko jitne zyada gaps mein baanto, har gap utna chhota.
sayAlt.en: Think of one laddu: share it between 2 children and each gets a big piece, between 5 and each gets a small one. The line is the same: the more gaps you cut 0 to 1 into, the smaller each gap.

prompt.hi: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
prompt.en: The first mark is 1/5, and the line is also cut into 7 equal gaps. Where does 1/7 go: between 0 and 1/5, or after 1/5?

reask.hi: 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
reask.en: Where does 1/7 go: between 0 and 1/5, or after 1/5?

viewCaption.hi: Ek taraf ki patti ka pehla gap rangin hai, 1/5. Doosri taraf ki patti utni hi lambi hai par saat barabar gaps mein, uska pehla gap bhi baayein kinaare se dekho.
viewCaption.en: The first gap on one side is coloured, 1/5. The other side is just as long but in seven equal gaps; look at its first gap from the left end too.

why.hi: 1/7 ka gap 1/5 ke gap se chhota hai, toh 1/7 wala mark 0 aur 1/5 ke beech aata hai
why.en: a 1/7 gap is shorter than a 1/5 gap, so the 1/7 mark comes between 0 and 1/5

whyShort.hi: 1/7 ka gap chhota, toh woh 1/5 se pehle
whyShort.en: a 1/7 gap is smaller, so it stops before 1/5

whyAlt.hi: 1/7 ko aage rakha kyunki 7 bada hai; par 7 gap bhi wahi 0 se 1 bharte hain; socho, 7 wala gap 5 wale se lamba hoga ya chhota
whyAlt.en: you put 1/7 after because 7 is bigger; but 7 gaps fill the same 0 to 1 too; think whether a gap of 7 is longer or shorter than a gap of 5

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono taraf ka pehla gap rangin hai. 1/7 wala rangin gap 1/5 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/7, 0 aur 1/5 ke beech aata hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The first gap of both sides is coloured. The coloured 1/7 gap is shorter than the 1/5 one, so 1/7 comes between 0 and 1/5.

simpler.hi: 7 gaps wali taraf 0 se pehla gap dekho, aur dekho woh 1/5 wale mark se pehle khatam hota hai ya aage.
simpler.en: On the 7-gap side look at the first gap from 0, and see whether it ends before the 1/5 mark or beyond it.

remediation.move: road from home (0) to the chai stall (1 km), one line in 7 equal gaps on top; a toy walks from home and stops at the first mark → it stands on one real spot of the road → that spot has one number, 1/7 km; then the same road in 6 gaps below: the toy stops at the first mark below → that spot is one number too, 1/6 km (the trap says 1 and 6); no top number above 1 yet (taught in s2)

say.hi: Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre.
say.en: The road from 0 to 1 kilometre is cut into 7 equal gaps. A toy stopped at the first mark: that is a fixed spot, and its number is 1/7 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Ghar se khilone tak sadak ka bas ek gap hai. Sadak jitne barabar gaps mein kati ho, us ek gap ka naam utne se banta hai.
simpler.en: From home to the toy is just one gap of the road. However many equal gaps the road is cut into, that one gap is named by that many.

sayAlt.hi: Socho, ruler par 0 ke baad pehli lakeer ek pakki jagah hai, aur uska ek number hai. Sadak par khilona bhi aisi hi ek pakki jagah par ruka hai, aur us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
sayAlt.en: Think of a ruler: the first line after 0 is a fixed spot, and it has a number. The toy on the road stopped at just such a fixed spot, and that spot has a number too.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh sadak hai, 0 se 1 kilometre tak: saat barabar gaps, aur pehle mark tak 1/7 kilometre, jahan khilona ruka.
viewCaption.en: This is the road from 0 to 1 kilometre: seven equal gaps, and 1/7 kilometre to the first mark, where the toy stopped.

prompt.hi: Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?
prompt.en: Now the same road, 0 to 1, is also cut into 6 equal gaps. The toy stopped at its first mark: how many kilometres?

reask.hi: 1 kilometre ki sadak 6 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh pehle mark par ruka khilona 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
reask.en: If a 1-kilometre road is cut into 6 equal gaps, how many kilometres from 0 is a toy that stopped at the first mark?

why.hi: 1/7 wala mark 7 gaps mein kati sadak par hai. Yahan 6 gaps wali sadak ka pehla mark dekho, aur naam unhi gaps se banao.
why.en: The 1/7 mark is on the road cut into 7 gaps. Here look at the first mark of the road in 6 gaps, and name it from those gaps.

why.hi: 1 kilometre toh poori sadak hai, ghar se 1 tak. Khilona sirf pehle mark tak ek gap chala; ek gap ka fraction socho.
why.en: 1 kilometre is the whole road, from home to 1. The toy went only one gap, to the first mark; think of one gap's fraction.

viewCaption.hi: Dono taraf ek hi sadak hai, 0 se 1 kilometre tak. Ek taraf pehla gap rangin hai, aur doosri taraf sadak chhe barabar gaps mein kati hai, abhi bina rang ke.
viewCaption.en: Both sides are the same road, from 0 to 1 kilometre. On one side the first gap is coloured, and on the other side the road is cut into six equal gaps, not coloured yet.

why.hi: yeh sadak 6 barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur khilona ghar se bas ek gap chala, toh 1/6 kilometre par
why.en: this road is in 6 equal gaps, and the toy went just one gap from home: 1/6 kilometre

whyShort.hi: ghar se ek gap, sadak 6 gaps mein: 1/6 kilometre
whyShort.en: one gap of the 6 from home: 1/6 kilometre

whyAlt.hi: 6 toh poori sadak ke gaps ki ginti hai, khilona utna nahi chala; woh 0 se ek hi gap chala, toh socho ek gap kitne kilometre ka hai
whyAlt.en: 6 is the count of the whole road's gaps, and the toy did not go that far; it went just one gap from 0, so think how many kilometres one gap is

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti wahi sadak hai, 6 barabar gaps mein, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai. Khilona us rangin gap ke ant par hai, 1/6 kilometre par.
answerViewCaption.en: The other side is the same road, in 6 equal gaps, and its first gap is coloured. The toy is at the end of that coloured gap, at 1/6 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Khilona ek hi gap chala, toh upar wala number 1 hai. Neeche wala number sadak ke saare barabar gaps ginta hai.
simpler.en: The toy walked just one gap, so the top number is 1. The bottom number counts all the equal gaps of the road.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we'll move more than one gap from 0, and a fraction's top number will tell us how many.

simpler.hi: Ab 0 se do, teen, ya usse bhi zyada gap chalkar fraction dhoondhenge.
simpler.en: Next we'll find fractions by walking two, three or more gaps from 0.

covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki har fraction ki line par ek pakki jagah hoti hai, aur uska naam gaps ginkar milta hai.
covered.en: Today we saw that every fraction has a fixed place on the line, and its name comes from counting gaps.

hook.convey: same 0-to-1 stretch cut into equal stretches; the stop is not the first mark but several stretches on → its name needs two facts: how many equal stretches make the whole (bottom), how many are covered from 0 (top)

use.hi: Cricket pitch ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto: batsman 0 wale stump se 3 gap paar karke ruka.
use.en: Split a cricket pitch into 4 equal gaps: the batsman ran from the stump at 0 and stopped after crossing 3 gaps.

use.hi: Game ki loading 0 se 1 tak, 5 barabar gaps mein bharti hai; abhi 2 gap bhari hai.
use.en: A game's loading fills from 0 to 1 in 5 equal gaps; right now 2 gaps are full.

explain.convey: thirds: bottom 3 → 0 to 1 in 3 equal gaps; top 2 → 2 hops of 1/3 from 0; landing mark = 2/3 → one point, one number, not 2 and 3 separately

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti teen barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle do gaps rangin hain, 2/3. Rang baayein kinaare se shuru hota hai, jaise line par 0 se gap chalna.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in three equal gaps, and the first two gaps are coloured, 2/3. The colour starts from the left end, like walking gaps from 0 on the line.

point.hi: Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number.
point.en: This time the line is cut into 3 equal gaps, each gap 1/3. Move 2 gaps from 0, one, two, and we're at 2/3. 2/3 is one place, one number.

pointAlt.hi: Chocolate se socho: 3 barabar hisson wali chocolate ke 2 hisse kha lo, toh tumne 2/3 chocolate khayi. Line par 1/3 wale 2 gap bhi waise hi 0 se 2/3 tak le jaate hain.
pointAlt.en: Think of a chocolate: eat 2 parts of a chocolate in 3 equal parts and you have eaten 2/3 of it. On the line, 2 gaps of 1/3 take you from 0 to 2/3 the same way.

prompt.hi: Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
prompt.en: This time the line is also cut into 8 equal gaps. Move 5 gaps from 0. Which fraction do you reach?

hindi.hi: Ab poori line 8 gap mein bhi bati hai. 0 se 5 gap aage jao, toh kaunsa fraction aata hai?
hindi.en: Now the whole line is split into 8 gaps too. Go 5 gaps on from 0: which fraction do you get?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line 8 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 se 5 gap chalkar kis fraction par pahunchoge?
reask.en: If the line from 0 to 1 is cut into 8 equal gaps, which fraction do you reach after 5 gaps from 0?

why.hi: har gap 1/8 ka, aur aise 5 gap mile toh 5/8
why.en: each gap is 1/8, and 5 of them make 5/8

whyShort.hi: 1/8 ke 5 gap, yaani 5/8
whyShort.en: 5 gaps of 1/8 make 5/8

whyAlt.hi: fraction ke naam mein do ginti hoti hain: neeche 0 se 1 tak ke saare gaps, upar 0 se chale gaps; is sawaal mein dono ginti di hui hain
whyAlt.en: a fraction's name holds two counts: below, all the gaps from 0 to 1; above, the gaps walked from 0; this question gives you both counts

simpler.hi: 8 gaps wali taraf 0 se ek-ek gap chalo aur paanch tak gino. Phir dekho, poore 1 tak aise kitne gap hain.
simpler.en: On the 8-gap side walk one gap at a time from 0 and count to five. Then see how many such gaps there are up to the whole 1.

viewCaption.hi: Ek taraf teen mein se do gaps rangin hain. Doosri taraf ki patti aath barabar gaps mein hai, bina rang ke, aur uske gaps bhi baayein kinaare se ek-ek karke gine jaate hain.
viewCaption.en: On one side two of the three gaps are coloured. The other side is in eight equal gaps, not coloured, and its gaps are counted one by one from the left end too.

simpler.hi: 2/3 ko '3 mein se 2' padho: line jitne gaps mein kati, woh 3; tum jitne chale, woh 2.
simpler.en: Read 2/3 as '2 out of 3': the line is cut into 3, and you moved 2.

explain.convey: still thirds: 3 hops of 1/3 → every gap used → land exactly on 1 → 3/3 = 1; top < bottom → stop before 1; top = bottom → reach 1

viewCaption.hi: Is patti ke teeno barabar gaps rangin hain, toh poori patti bhar gayi. Koi gap khaali nahi bacha.
viewCaption.en: All three equal gaps of this strip are coloured, so the whole strip is filled. No gap is left empty.

point.hi: Ab 1/3 wale 3 gap chalkar dekho: teesre gap ke ant par hum theek 1 par hain, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1. Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain.
point.en: Now walk 3 gaps of 1/3: at the end of the third gap we are exactly at 1, so there 3/3 = 1. The three gaps together fill the whole line from 0 to 1.

pointAlt.hi: Pizza ke 3 barabar hisse hon aur teeno le lo, toh poora pizza aa gaya: 3/3 ek poora hai. Line par bhi 3 mein se 3 gap chalkar hum poore 1 par hote hain.
pointAlt.en: If a pizza has 3 equal parts and you take all three, you have the whole pizza: 3/3 is one whole. On the line too, 3 gaps out of 3 put us on the whole 1.

prompt.hi: Ab socho, ek doosri line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati ho. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?
prompt.en: Now imagine another line cut into gaps of 1/5. How many such gaps do you move from 0 to reach exactly 1?

reask.hi: Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se theek 1 tak kitne gap chalne honge?
reask.en: If each gap is 1/5, how many gaps from 0 to exactly 1?

why.hi: 1/5 ke 5 gap milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1
why.en: 5 gaps of 1/5 make 5/5, and 5/5 = 1

whyShort.hi: 1/5 ke 5 gap se 5/5 = 1
whyShort.en: 5 gaps of 1/5 make 1

whyAlt.hi: 4 gap chalkar tum 4/5 par ho, aur 4/5 abhi 1 se pehle hai; 1 tab aata hai jab upar aur neeche ka number barabar ho jaaye
whyAlt.en: walking 4 gaps puts you at 4/5, and 4/5 is still before 1; you reach 1 when the top and bottom numbers become equal

simpler.hi: 1/3 wale teen gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte the. Ab socho, 1/5 jitne chhote gap poore 1 ko bharne ke liye kitne lagenge.
simpler.en: Three gaps of 1/3 together filled 0 to 1. Now think how many gaps as small as 1/5 it takes to fill the whole 1.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti teen barabar gaps mein hai, aur teeno gaps rangin hain: 0 se 1 tak poori bhari. 1/5 wale gaps abhi bane nahi, unhe tumhe sochna hai.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in three equal gaps, all three coloured: filled from 0 to 1. The gaps of 1/5 are not drawn yet; you have to imagine them.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 tak ki ek patti hai, teen barabar gaps mein, aur teeno rangin: 1/3 ke teen gap milkar poora 1 bharte hain. 1/5 wale gaps tumhe sochne hain.
pictureCaption.en: This is one strip from 0 to 1, in three equal gaps, all three coloured: three gaps of 1/3 together fill the whole 1. The gaps of 1/5 are for you to imagine.

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti ab paanch barabar gaps mein hai, aur paanchon rangin: 1/5 ke paanch gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte hain, 5/5 = 1.
answerViewCaption.en: The other side is now in five equal gaps, all five coloured: five gaps of 1/5 together fill 0 to 1, 5/5 = 1.

simpler.hi: 3 barabar gaps wali line par teeno gap chalo toh 1 aata hai. Ek bhi gap baaki nahi bachta, isliye chalna theek 1 par rukta hai.
simpler.en: On a line of 3 equal gaps, move all three and you reach 1. Not one gap is left over, so the walk stops exactly at 1.

explain.convey: each third cut in 2 → 6 equal gaps; the middle = half of the 6 gaps = 3 gaps → 3/6 = 1/2; fewer than half the gaps (2/6) → before the middle; more than half (5/6) → after the middle

viewCaption.hi: Teen ek jaisi pattiyaan hain, har ek chhe barabar gaps mein. Pehli mein do gaps rangin, doosri mein teen, aur teesri mein paanch, aur doosri ka rang theek aadhi patti tak hai.
viewCaption.en: There are three identical strips, each in six equal gaps. The first has two gaps coloured, the second three, and the third five, and the second one's colour reaches exactly half the strip.

point.hi: Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Beech ka mark 3/6 = 1/2 hai, kyunki 3, 6 ka aadha hai. 2/6 usse pehle aata hai, 5/6 baad mein.
point.en: Now the line has 6 equal gaps. The middle mark is 3/6 = 1/2, because 3 is half of 6. 2/6 comes before it, 5/6 after.

pointAlt.hi: Roti ke 6 barabar hisse socho: 3 hisse le lo toh theek aadhi roti hai, isliye 3/6 = 1/2 beech mein hai. 2 hisse aadhi se kam hain, toh 2/6 beech se pehle, aur 5 hisse aadhi se zyada, toh 5/6 beech ke baad.
pointAlt.en: Think of a roti in 6 equal parts: take 3 and you have exactly half, so 3/6 = 1/2 is the middle. 2 parts are less than half, so 2/6 comes before the middle, and 5 parts are more than half, so 5/6 after it.

prompt.hi: 0 se 1 ki ek nayi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
prompt.en: A new line from 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal gaps. Does 4/10 come before the middle, or after it?

viewCaption.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 ki nayi patti hai, das barabar gaps mein, aur kisi gap par rang ya naam nahi. Beech kahan hai, yeh bhi gaps ginkar tumhe khud dhoondhna hai.
viewCaption.en: This is the new strip from 0 to 1, in ten equal gaps, with no gap coloured or named. Where the middle is, you find yourself too, by counting gaps.

reask.hi: 10 barabar gaps wali is line par 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
reask.en: On this line of 10 equal gaps, does 4/10 come before the middle, or after it?

why.hi: 10 gaps ka beech 5 gap par hai, 5/10; 4/10 usse ek gap pehle hai, toh beech se pehle
why.en: the middle of 10 gaps is at 5 gaps, 5/10; 4/10 is one gap short of it, so before the middle

whyShort.hi: beech 5/10 par, aur 4/10 usse ek gap pehle
whyShort.en: the middle is 5/10; 4/10 is one gap before it

whyAlt.hi: 6 gaps wali line ka beech 3 gap par tha; is line mein 10 gaps hain, toh pehle iska beech dhoondho, phir dekho 4 gap usse pehle hain ya baad
whyAlt.en: On the line of 6 gaps the middle was 3 gaps along; this line has 10 gaps, so first find its middle, then see whether 4 gaps come before it or after

simpler.hi: Pehle 10 gaps ka aadha nikaalo: wahi beech hai. Phir 0 se 4 gap chalo, aur dekho tum kahan ruke.
simpler.en: First find half of 10 gaps: that is the middle. Then walk 4 gaps from 0, and see where you stopped.

simpler.hi: Beech wala mark 3/6 hai, teen gap par. 2/6 ke liye do gap chalo toh tum beech se pehle rukte ho, aur 5/6 ke liye paanch gap chalo toh beech ke aage nikal jaate ho.
simpler.en: The middle mark is 3/6, three gaps along. Move two gaps for 2/6 and you stop before the middle; move five for 5/6 and you go past it.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai.
problem.en: A number line goes from 0 to 1. We need to find the mark for 2/5 on it.

problemAlt.hi: Ek cheenti 0 se 2/5 tak jaana chahti hai. Use do baatein pata honi chahiye: ek gap kitna lamba hai, aur aise kitne gap chalne hain.
problemAlt.en: An ant wants to go from 0 to 2/5. It needs to know two things: how long one gap is, and how many such gaps to walk.

simpler.hi: Jaise pate ki do cheezein milkar ek hi ghar batati hain, waise hi 2/5 ke do number milkar line par ek jagah batate hain: ek number gap ka size batata hai, doosra kitne gap chalne hain.
simpler.en: Just as two parts of an address together name one house, the two numbers of 2/5 together name one spot on the line: one number sets the size of a gap, the other says how many gaps to move.

givens.hi: 0 se 1 ki ek line, aur fraction 2/5
givens.en: a line from 0 to 1, and the fraction 2/5

prompt.hi: 2/5 mein kaunsa number line ke barabar gaps ginta hai: 2 ya 5?
prompt.en: In 2/5, which number counts the line's equal gaps: 2 or 5?

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh ek poori patti hai, 0 se 1 jitni lambi, aur us par abhi ek bhi kat nahi laga.
pictureCaption.en: This is one whole strip, as long as 0 to 1, with not a single cut on it yet.

hindi.hi: 2/5 mein do number hain, 2 aur 5. Line ko barabar gaps mein kaatne ke liye inmein se kaunsa number dekhoge?
hindi.en: 2/5 has two numbers, 2 and 5. To cut the line into equal gaps, which of them will you look at?

reask.hi: Line kaatne wala number kaunsa hai, 2 ya 5?
reask.en: Which number cuts the line, 2 or 5?

whyAlt.hi: 2 toh 0 se chalne wale gaps ki ginti hai; kaatne ke liye woh number chahiye jo batata hai ki poore 0 se 1 mein kitne gaps hain
whyAlt.en: 2 is the count of gaps to walk from 0; for cutting you need the number that says how many gaps the whole of 0 to 1 holds

right.hi: Haan, 5: neeche wala 5 batata hai 0 se 1 kitne barabar gaps mein kate.
right.en: Yes, 5: the bottom 5 says how many equal gaps cut 0 to 1.

steps.result: 0 se 1 ke 5 barabar gaps, har gap 1/5

why.hi: neeche wala number batata hai ki 0 se 1 kitne barabar gaps mein bant-ta hai
why.en: the bottom number says how many equal gaps 0 to 1 is split into

told.hi: Neeche wala 5 kehta hai: 0 se 1 ki line ko 5 barabar gaps mein kaato. Toh har gap 1/5 ka hai.
told.en: The bottom 5 says: cut the line from 0 to 1 into 5 equal gaps. So each gap is 1/5.

simpler.hi: 2/5 ka ek number 0 se 1 tak ke saare gaps ginta hai, doosra sirf 0 se chale hue gaps.
simpler.en: One number of 2/5 counts all the gaps from 0 to 1, the other only the gaps walked from 0.

steps.result: har gap ke ant par ek mark

why.hi: mark ka naam 0 se gine gaps se aata hai
why.en: a mark's name comes from the gaps counted from 0

told.hi: Ab 0 se 1/5 ka ek-ek gap chalte hain; har gap ke ant par ek mark aata hai.
told.en: Now we walk from 0 one gap of 1/5 at a time; at the end of each gap comes a mark.

simpler.hi: Ungli 0 par rakho aur ek gap aage badhao: wahan pehla mark hai.
simpler.en: Put a finger on 0 and move it one gap on: the first mark is there.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
prompt.en: Your turn: for 2/5, at which mark after 0 do you stop?

reask.hi: 2/5 dikhane ke liye, 5 gaps wali is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
reask.en: To show 2/5 on this line of 5 gaps, at which mark after 0 do you stop?

why.hi: upar wala number 2 kehta hai 1/5 ke do gap chalo, isliye hum doosre mark par rukte hain
why.en: the top number 2 says take two gaps of 1/5, so we stop at the second mark

whyAlt.hi: pehla mark 0 se sirf ek gap par hai, 1/5 par; upar wala 2 kehta hai ki gap aur chalne hain, toh pehle mark par rukna jaldi hai
whyAlt.en: the first mark is only one gap from 0, at 1/5; the top 2 says there are more gaps to walk, so stopping at the first mark is too soon

simpler.hi: 2/5 ka upar wala number 2 hai. 0 se ek-ek gap karke chalo, aur gino.
simpler.en: The top number of 2/5 is 2. Step from 0 one gap at a time, and count.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, ab paanch barabar gaps mein kati, ek patti ki tarah. Koi gap rangin nahi; 0 wale sire se gaps tumhe khud chalne hain.
viewCaption.en: This is the same line from 0 to 1, now cut into five equal gaps, like a strip. No gap is coloured; you walk the gaps yourself from the 0 end.

why.hi: upar wala number 2 kehta hai 0 se 1/5 ke 2 gap chalo
why.en: the top number 2 says move 2 gaps of 1/5 from 0

viewCaption.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, abhi bilkul bina kati: ek sire par 0, doosre par 1, beech mein koi mark nahi.
viewCaption.en: This is the line from 0 to 1, not cut at all yet: 0 at one end, 1 at the other, no mark in between.

prompt.hi: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 marks lage hain, aur saare gaps ek jitne hain. 0 ke baad chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: This line has 5 marks between 0 and 1, and all the gaps are the same. What fraction is the 4th mark after 0?

hindi.hi: 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 se ginti karo: chauthe mark ka naam kya hai?
hindi.en: 5 marks sit evenly spaced between 0 and 1. Count from 0: what is the fourth mark's name?

reask.hi: 5 marks wali line par chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: On the line with 5 marks, which fraction is the fourth mark?

did.hi: 5 marks wali line par chauthe mark ka fraction nikala
did.en: named the 4th mark's fraction on a line of 5 marks

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur baayein kinaare se kuch gaps rangin hain. Rang wahan khatam hota hai jahan line par chautha mark tha.
viewCaption.en: This strip is cut into equal gaps, and some gaps are coloured from the left end. The colour ends where the fourth mark was on the line.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 tak ki ek poori patti hai, barabar gaps mein kati, aur koi gap rangin nahi. Gaps ke beech ke kinaare line ke marks hain.
pictureCaption.en: This is one whole strip from 0 to 1, cut into equal gaps, with no gap coloured. The edges between the gaps are the line's marks.

why.hi: 5 marks se 6 barabar gaps bante hain, aur chautha mark 4 gaps par hai: 4/6, jo 2/3 ke barabar hai
why.en: 5 marks make 6 equal gaps, and the 4th mark is 4 gaps along: 4/6, which is the same as 2/3

whyShort.hi: 5 marks se 6 gaps; chautha mark 4 gaps par
whyShort.en: 5 marks, 6 gaps; the 4th mark is 4 gaps

whyAlt.hi: 4/5 mein upar ka 4 theek hai, par neeche ka 5 marks ki ginti hai; neeche wala number 0 se 1 tak ke gaps batata hai, marks nahi
whyAlt.en: in 4/5 the top 4 is right, but the bottom 5 is the count of marks; the bottom number tells the gaps from 0 to 1, not the marks

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle chaar gaps rangin hain. Rang chauthe mark tak jaata hai, isliye woh mark 4/6 hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 6 equal gaps, and the first four gaps are coloured. The colour reaches the fourth mark, so that mark is 4/6.

simpler.hi: Pehle gaps gino, woh marks se ek zyada hote hain. Phir 0 se chaar gap chalo.
simpler.en: First count the gaps, one more than the marks. Then walk four gaps from 0.

prompt.hi: Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?
prompt.en: The line has gaps of 1/5 and gaps of 1/10 too. How many gaps of 1/10 do you move to reach 3/5?

hindi.hi: Bade gap 1/5 ke hain, chhote gap 1/10 ke. 3/5 tak sirf chhote gap chalne hon, toh kitne lagenge?
hindi.en: The big gaps are 1/5 each, the small ones 1/10. If you walk only small gaps up to 3/5, how many will it take?

reask.hi: 0 se 3/5 tak 1/10 ke kitne gap chalne honge?
reask.en: How many gaps of 1/10 from 0 to 3/5?

did.hi: 3/5 tak ki doori 1/10 ke gaps mein naapi
did.en: measured the way to 3/5 in gaps of 1/10

viewCaption.hi: Line ki dono taraf barabar lambi pattiyan hain, ek taraf ki patti paanch barabar gaps mein, doosri das mein. Ek taraf ki patti ka har gap doosri taraf ki patti ke gaps ke saamne rakhkar dekho.
viewCaption.en: There are strips of the same length on both sides of the line, one side in five equal gaps, the other in ten. Look at each gap on one side against the gaps of the other.

why.hi: har 1/5 gap mein 1/10 ke do gap aate hain, toh 3/5 tak 1/10 ke 6 gap hain
why.en: each 1/5 gap holds two 1/10 gaps, so 3/5 is 6 gaps of 1/10

whyShort.hi: har 1/5 mein do 1/10, toh 6 gap
whyShort.en: two 1/10 in each 1/5: 6 gaps

whyAlt.hi: 3 toh tumne 1/5 wale bade gap gine hain; sawaal 1/10 wale chhote gaps ka hai, aur chhote gaps se utni hi door jaane mein gap zyada lagte hain
whyAlt.en: 3 is the count of the big 1/5 gaps; the question asks about the small 1/10 gaps, and going the same distance in small gaps takes more of them

answerViewCaption.hi: Ek taraf 3/5 tak rang hai, doosri mein 6/10 tak, aur dono rang ek hi jagah rukte hain. Isliye 3/5 tak 1/10 ke 6 gap hain.
answerViewCaption.en: One side is coloured up to 3/5, the other up to 6/10, and both colours stop at the same place. So 3/5 is 6 gaps of 1/10.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho, 1/5 ke ek gap mein 1/10 ke kitne gap samaate hain. Phir teen bade gaps ke liye socho.
simpler.en: First see how many gaps of 1/10 fit in one gap of 1/5. Then think it through for three big gaps.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 3/4 do number hain, 3 aur 4. 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 ki jagah batane ke liye tum kitne mark par ungli rakhoge?
prompt.en: {friend} says 3/4 is two numbers, 3 and 4. To point out where 3/4 is on a 0-to-1 line, on how many marks will you put your finger?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 ki jagah batane ke liye kitne mark par ungli rakhoge?
reask.en: To point out where 3/4 is on a 0-to-1 line, on how many marks will you put your finger?

did.hi: pehchaana ki 3/4 line par do nahi, ek hi jagah hai
did.en: saw that 3/4 is one place on the line, not two

viewCaption.hi: 0 se 1 tak ki line ab ek poori patti hai, chaar barabar gaps mein. 3/4 ka upar wala aur neeche wala number is patti par kya batate hain, yeh socho.
viewCaption.en: The line from 0 to 1 is now one whole strip in four equal gaps. Think what the top and the bottom number of 3/4 tell you on this strip.

why.hi: 3/4 akela ek number hai, toh line par uski sirf ek jagah hai: 0 se 3 gap chalkar, wahi ek mark
why.en: 3/4 is a single number, so it has just one place on the line: 3 gaps on from 0, that one mark

whyShort.hi: 3/4 ek number hai, toh line par ek mark
whyShort.en: 3/4 is one number, so one mark on the line

whyAlt.hi: 3 aur 4 yahan line par alag-alag jagah nahi hain: 3/4 mein 4 gaps ki ginti hai aur 3 chalne ki, aur dono milkar 0 se chalne ka pata batate hain
whyAlt.en: 3 and 4 are not separate places on the line here: in 3/4, 4 counts the gaps and 3 counts the walking, and together they tell you where to walk from 0

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 4 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle teen gaps rangin hain. Rang ek hi jagah rukta hai, aur wahi 3/4 ka ek mark hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 4 equal gaps, and the first three gaps are coloured. The colour stops at one place, and that is the one mark for 3/4.

simpler.hi: 3/4 ka neeche wala number 4 line ke barabar gaps banata hai, upar wala number 3 batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai. Ab line par chalo aur gino tum kitni jagah ruke.
simpler.en: The bottom number 4 of 3/4 makes the line's equal gaps, and the top number 3 says how many gaps to walk from 0. Now walk the line and count how many places you stopped.

ladder.why: den 4: quarters already known from s1 and the c4 roti → carry a shaded 3 of 4 onto the line; top = gaps moved
den 3: before or after the middle with thirds → 1/3 before, 2/3 after; carries e3's middle test (sixths) to a den whose middle is not a mark
den 5 reversed: given the mark, name the fraction → 4/5 km; read the line instead of marking it
den 10: each fifth split in 2 → many small gaps, unit given as 1/10 km → 7 steps = 7/10
den 8 against den 4 → two different cuts, same stopping point (6/8 = 3/4); closes the loop back to quarters

remediation.move: marks to gaps on one line, quarters on top: 3 marks inside → 4 gaps, since there is a gap before the first mark and after the last (gaps = marks + 1); each gap = 1/4; 0 is the start, not a gap; 2 gaps → 2/4; then below: 9 marks → 10 gaps → one gap is 1/10 (the trap says 1/9). Not c1's case (5 marks, sixths)

say.hi: 0 se pehle mark tak ek gap, doosre tak do. Neeche wala number gaps se aata hai: 0 aur 1 ke beech 3 marks, 4 gap.
say.en: From 0 to the first mark is one gap, to the second two. The bottom number comes from the gaps: 3 marks between 0 and 1, 4 gaps.

simpler.hi: Marks ko kainchi ke kat socho: 3 kat lagao toh ribbon ke 4 hisse bante hain. Line par bhi 3 marks se 4 gap.
simpler.en: Think of the marks as scissor cuts: make 3 cuts and the ribbon is in 4 pieces. On the line too, 3 marks make 4 gaps.

sayAlt.hi: Chhota karke dekho: 0 aur 1 ke beech sirf 2 marks hon, toh gap 3 bante hain: 0 se pehle mark tak, phir doosre mark tak, phir 1 tak. Is line par bhi 3 marks ke 4 gap hain, isliye har gap 1/4.
sayAlt.en: Try it smaller: with just 2 marks between 0 and 1 there are 3 gaps: 0 to the first mark, then to the second, then to 1. On this line too, 3 marks give 4 gaps, so each gap is 1/4.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti chaar barabar gaps mein hai: line ke teen marks yahan gaps ke beech ke kinaare hain.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in four equal gaps: the line's three marks are the edges between the gaps here.

prompt.hi: Ab line par zero aur ek ke beech 9 marks barabar doori par lage hain. Wahan ek gap kitne ka hai?
prompt.en: Now 9 marks sit evenly spaced on the line between zero and one. How much is one gap there?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ke beech 9 marks barabar doori par lage hon, toh ek gap kitne ka hai?
reask.en: If 9 equally spaced marks sit between 0 and 1, how much is one gap?

viewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti ke gaps ke beech ke marks hi line ki doosri taraf ke marks hain, aur ek taraf chaar gaps hain, do rangin.
viewCaption.en: The marks between the other side's gaps are the marks on the other side of the line, and one side has four gaps, two coloured.

why.hi: beech ke 9 marks line ko 10 barabar gaps mein baant-te hain, toh har gap 1/10
why.en: the 9 marks in between split the line into 10 equal gaps, so each gap is 1/10

whyShort.hi: 9 marks, 10 gaps: har gap 1/10
whyShort.en: 9 marks, 10 gaps: each is 1/10

whyAlt.hi: 1/9 tab hota jab line 9 gaps mein hoti; par 9 toh beech ke marks hain, aur 0 ke baad aur 1 se pehle bhi ek-ek gap hai
whyAlt.en: 1/9 would be right if the line were in 9 gaps; but 9 is the marks in between, and there is one gap after 0 and one before 1 too

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti 10 barabar gaps mein hai, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai. Line ki doosri taraf ke 9 marks ne yahi 10 gaps banaye, toh har gap 1/10 hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The other side is in 10 equal gaps, and its first gap is coloured. The 9 marks on the other side of the line made these 10 gaps, so each gap is 1/10.

simpler.hi: Gap marks ke beech bhi hain aur dono siron par bhi. Pehle kul gap gino, phir socho ek gap kitne ka hai.
simpler.en: There are gaps between the marks and at both ends. First count all the gaps, then think what one gap is worth.

remediation.move: same number of hops, different hop size, on one 0-to-1 line, thirds on top, sixths below: a 1/3 hop is two 1/6 hops long; 2 hops of 1/6 stop at 2/6, 2 hops of 1/3 at 2/3 → bigger bottom number = shorter hops; then: 3 hops of 1/6 against 2/3

say.hi: Lamba gap 1/3 hai, aur chhota gap usse aadha, 1/6. 2 lambe gap 2/3 par rukte hain, 2 chhote 2/6 par.
say.en: The long gap is 1/3, and the short gap half that, 1/6. 2 long gaps stop at 2/3, 2 short ones at 2/6.

simpler.hi: Dono taraf do-do gap hain. 1/3 wala gap bada, toh 2/3 aage, aur 1/6 wala chhota, toh 2/6 peeche.
simpler.en: Two gaps each side. The 1/3 gap is bigger, so 2/3 is further on, and the 1/6 gap is smaller, so 2/6 stays back.

sayAlt.hi: Ek glass mein 2 bade chammach cheeni daalo, doosre mein 2 chhote chammach: ginti dono mein 2, par bade chammach wale mein zyada cheeni. Line par bhi 1/3 ke 2 lambe gap, 1/6 ke 2 chhote gap se aage pahunchte hain.
sayAlt.en: Put 2 big spoons of sugar in one glass and 2 small spoons in another: the count is 2 in both, but the big-spoon glass has more sugar. On the line too, 2 long gaps of 1/3 reach further than 2 short gaps of 1/6.

viewCaption.hi: Ek taraf ki patti ke do rangin gaps lambe hain, doosri taraf ki patti ke do rangin gaps chhote. Dono mein rangin gaps do-do hain, par rang kahan tak pahuncha, woh alag hai.
viewCaption.en: One side's two coloured gaps are long, the other side's two coloured gaps short. Both have two coloured gaps, but how far the colour reaches is different.

prompt.hi: 1/3 ke 2 gap 2/3 tak gaye. Ab 1/6 ke 3 gap: woh 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya baad mein?
prompt.en: 2 gaps of 1/3 went to 2/3. Now 3 gaps of 1/6: will they stop before 2/3, or after?

reask.hi: 1/6 ke 3 gap 0 se chalkar 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya 2/3 ke baad?
reask.en: Do 3 gaps of 1/6 from 0 stop before 2/3, or after 2/3?

viewCaption.hi: Doosri taraf ki patti chhe barabar gaps mein hai, aur uske do chhote gaps rangin hain; ek taraf teen mein se do lambe gaps rangin. Doosri taraf ki patti ke gaps baayein kinaare se ek-ek karke ek taraf ki patti ke rang se milaao.
viewCaption.en: The other side is in six equal gaps, with two short gaps coloured; one side has two of its three long gaps coloured. Set the other side's gaps, one by one from the left end, against the colour on the first side.

why.hi: 1/6 ke 3 gap sirf beech tak jaate hain, aur 2/3 beech se aage hai
why.en: 3 gaps of 1/6 reach only the middle, and 2/3 is past the middle

whyShort.hi: 3 gap sirf beech tak; 2/3 beech se aage
whyShort.en: 3 gaps reach the middle; 2/3 is past it

whyAlt.hi: Tumne 3 ko 2 se bada dekha. Par yahan gap ki lambai bhi dekhni hai: 1/6 wala gap 1/3 wale ka aadha hai.
whyAlt.en: You saw 3 as bigger than 2. But here the length of a gap matters too: a 1/6 gap is half of a 1/3 gap.

answerViewCaption.hi: Ek taraf do lambe gaps rangin hain, doosri mein teen chhote. Doosri taraf ka rang ek taraf wale rang se pehle ruk jaata hai, isliye 3/6, 2/3 se pehle aata hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Two long gaps on one side are coloured, three short ones of the other. The other side's colour stops before the first side's, so 3/6 comes before 2/3.

simpler.hi: Do chhote 1/6 gap milkar ek lamba 1/3 gap banate hain. Ab socho, 2 lambe gap jitni doori ke liye kitne chhote gap chahiye.
simpler.en: Two short 1/6 gaps make one long 1/3 gap. Now think how many short gaps cover the distance of 2 long gaps.

remediation.move: on the then-card's own board (a 0-to-1 km line in eighths, the third stone marked), naming none of its numbers: each mark is a stone, one real spot of the road; wherever the toy stops it stands on one spot, so that spot has one number, a fraction, not two numbers; then the toy at the third stone → say it as one number, 3/8 km

say.hi: Line par har mark sadak ka ek patthar hai, ek pakki jagah. Khilona jis patthar par ruke, us jagah ka number ek hi hai: ek fraction.
say.en: Every mark on the line is a stone on a road, a fixed spot. Whichever stone the toy stops at, that spot has one number: a fraction.

simpler.hi: Khilone ki jagah ko do number mein bolo toh lagta hai do jagah hain, par board par mark ek hi hai. Ek mark, ek hi number; do alag number nahi.
simpler.en: Say the toy's spot as two numbers and it sounds like two places, but the board has only one mark. One mark, one number; not two separate numbers.

sayAlt.hi: Aadha kilo aata socho, yaani 1/2 kilo: likhne mein 1 aur 2 dono dikhte hain, par woh ek hi wazan hai. Har fraction aisa hi hai: ek number, aur line par uski ek hi jagah.
sayAlt.en: Think of half a kilo of flour, that is 1/2 kilo: written, it shows a 1 and a 2, but it is one weight. Every fraction is like that: one number, with one place on the line.

viewCaption.hi: Is patti ko sadak samjho: gaps ke beech ka har kinaara ek patthar hai.
viewCaption.en: Take this strip as a road: every edge between the gaps is a stone.

prompt.hi: Har 1/8 kilometre par patthar hai. Khilona teesre patthar par hai: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
prompt.en: A stone every 1/8 kilometre. The toy stands at the third stone: how many kilometres from 0 is it?

reask.hi: Har 1/8 kilometre par patthar ho, toh 0 ke baad teesra patthar kitne kilometre par hai?
reask.en: With a stone every 1/8 kilometre, at how many kilometres is the third stone after 0?

viewCaption.hi: Yeh wahi sadak hai: rang 0 se shuru hokar ek mark par rukta hai. Poori patti ke gaps bhi dekho aur rangin gaps bhi.
viewCaption.en: This is the same road: the colour starts at 0 and stops at one mark. Look at all the strip's gaps, and at the coloured ones too.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh wahi sadak hai, 0 se 1 kilometre tak, barabar gaps mein kati, bina rang ke. Gaps ke beech ka har kinaara ek patthar hai.
pictureCaption.en: This is the same road, from 0 to 1 kilometre, cut into equal gaps, with no colour. Every edge between the gaps is a stone.

why.hi: har patthar 1/8 kilometre aage hai, toh teesra patthar 3/8 kilometre par
why.en: each stone is 1/8 kilometre further on, so the third stone is at 3/8 kilometre

whyShort.hi: har patthar 1/8 aage, toh teesra 3/8 kilometre par
whyShort.en: each stone is 1/8 on; the third, 3/8 kilometre

whyAlt.hi: 3 toh chale hue gaps ki ginti hai, kilometre nahi; har gap sirf 1/8 kilometre ka hai, toh socho 3 aise gap kitne kilometre hue
whyAlt.en: 3 is the count of gaps walked, not kilometres; each gap is only 1/8 kilometre, so think how many kilometres 3 such gaps make

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 8 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle teen gaps rangin hain. Rang teesre patthar par rukta hai, yaani 3/8 kilometre par.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 8 equal gaps, and the first three gaps are coloured. The colour stops at the third stone, at 3/8 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Patthar se patthar 1/8 kilometre hai. Shuru se teesre patthar tak aise kitne gap hain, gino.
simpler.en: Stone to stone is 1/8 kilometre. Count how many of those gaps there are from the start to the third stone.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab fraction 1 ke aage bhi jaayenge: line kabhi 2 tak chalegi, kabhi 3 tak, aur dekhenge ki 1 se bade fraction kahan aate hain.
bridgeToNext.en: Next, fractions go past 1: the line will run to 2, sometimes to 3, and we'll see where fractions bigger than 1 sit.

simpler.hi: Ab hum 1 par nahi rukenge: 0 se itne gap chalenge ki 1 bhi peeche chhoot jaaye.
simpler.en: Now we won't stop at 1: we'll walk so many gaps from 0 that we leave 1 behind.

covered.hi: Phir upar wala number aaya, jo batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai; dono milkar ek jagah batate hain.
covered.en: Then came the top number, which says how many gaps to go from 0; together the two name one place.

hook.convey: one whole is finished and the mover keeps going → the stopping point is past 1 → it needs a fraction name bigger than 1 → the line must go on beyond 1

use.hi: Cricket mein ek run matlab pitch ki poori lambai, 1; batsman doosre run ke beech ruka, 1 se aage.
use.en: In cricket one run is the pitch's whole length, 1; the batsman stopped partway through a second run, past 1.

use.hi: Train station 0 se chali, station 1 paar kiya, aur station 2 se pehle ruki: 1 ke aage.
use.en: A train left station 0, passed station 1 and stopped before station 2: past 1.

explain.convey: the line does not stop at 1 → it carries on to 2; the second whole is cut the same way → 4 equal gaps per whole, all the same size; 4 gaps from 0 = 4/4 = 1; the gap count from 0 keeps growing past 4

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab poori pattiyon mein hai, ek ke baad ek, aur har patti chaar barabar gaps mein. Pehli patti poori rangi hai, aur uske sire par 4/4 = 1 likha hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now whole strips, one after another, each in four equal gaps. The first strip is coloured all the way, and at its end it reads 4/4 = 1.

point.hi: Yeh rahi 0 se 2 tak ki line. Har poore ke 4 barabar gaps hain, toh 4 gap chalkar 1 aata hai: 4/4 = 1. 1 ke aage bhi gaps usi size mein chalte rehte hain.
point.en: Here is a line from 0 to 2. Each whole has 4 equal gaps, so 4 gaps bring you to 1: 4/4 = 1. Beyond 1 the gaps keep going, same size.

pointAlt.hi: Apna ruler dekho: woh 1 cm par khatam nahi hota, 2, 3, aur aage tak chalta hai. Number line bhi waise hi 1 ke baad chalti rehti hai, aur wahan bhi har poore mein 4 barabar gaps hain.
pointAlt.en: Look at your ruler: it doesn't end at 1 cm, it goes on to 2, 3 and further. The number line carries on after 1 the same way, and there too each whole has 4 equal gaps.

prompt.hi: Ab line 1/5 wale gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 6 gap chalo: ab tum kis fraction par ho?
prompt.en: Now the line is also cut into gaps of 1/5. Move 6 gaps from 0: which fraction are you on now?

hindi.hi: Ab 1/5 ke gap bhi bane hain. 0 se shuru karke 6 gap aage jao; jahan ruke, us jagah ka naam kya hai?
hindi.en: Now there are gaps of 1/5 too. Start at 0 and go 6 gaps on; where you stop, what is that place's name?

reask.hi: Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se 6 gap chalkar tum kis fraction par khade ho?
reask.en: If each gap is 1/5, which fraction are you standing on after 6 gaps from 0?

why.hi: 5 gap se 5/5 = 1 aa gaya, aur chhatha gap 1 ke aage, 6/5 par, yaani 1 aur 1/5
why.en: 5 gaps already make 5/5 = 1, and the 6th gap goes past 1, to 6/5, that is 1 and 1/5

whyShort.hi: 5 gap se 1, chhatha gap 6/5 par
whyShort.en: 5 gaps reach 1; the 6th is at 6/5

whyAlt.hi: 1/5 sirf ek gap ka naam hai; tumne 6 gap chale, aur upar wala number chale hue saare gaps ki ginti hota hai, 1 ke aage wale bhi
whyAlt.en: 1/5 is the name of just one gap; you walked 6 gaps, and the top number counts all the gaps walked, the ones past 1 too

simpler.hi: 1/5 wale gaps par 0 se gino, aur dekho ki 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne gap lagte hain.
simpler.en: Count along the gaps of 1/5 from 0, and see how many gaps it takes to reach 1.

viewCaption.hi: Ab line ki dono taraf pattiyan hain: ek taraf har patti chaar gaps mein, doosri taraf paanch. Ek taraf ki rangi patti dikhati hai ki 1 kahan hai; doosri taraf ki patti ke gaps 0 se ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: Now there are strips on both sides of the line: on one side each strip is in four gaps, on the other side five. The coloured strip on one side shows where 1 is; look at the other side's gaps one by one from 0.

simpler.hi: 1 se 2 tak ki line bhi 0 se 1 jitni hi lambi hai, aur usmein bhi utne hi gap hain.
simpler.en: The stretch from 1 to 2 is just as long as 0 to 1, and it has just as many gaps.

explain.convey: 6 hops of 1/4 from 0: the first 4 hops fill one whole → reach 1; 2 more hops → past 1 → 6/4 = 1 and 2/4; top > bottom → beyond 1

viewCaption.hi: Line ab poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti chaar barabar gaps mein. 0 se 6/4 tak ke gaps rangin hain: pehli patti poori, aur agli ke do gaps.
viewCaption.en: The line is now whole strips end to end, each in four equal gaps. The gaps from 0 up to 6/4 are coloured: the first strip in full, and two gaps of the next.

point.hi: 0 se 1/4 ke chhe gap chalo: 4 gap 1 tak, phir do aur, 6/4 tak. Upar wala number 6 neeche ke 4 se bada, isliye 6/4, 1 ke aage hai.
point.en: Walk six gaps of 1/4 from 0: 4 gaps to 1, then two more, to 6/4. The top number 6 is bigger than the bottom 4, so 6/4 is past 1.

pointAlt.hi: Ek jug mein 4 glass paani aata hai: 6 glass daalo toh ek jug bhar jaata hai aur 2 glass doosre jug mein jaate hain. 6/4 bhi aisa hi hai: ek poora, aur uske aage 2/4.
pointAlt.en: A jug holds 4 glasses of water: pour in 6 glasses and one jug fills, and 2 glasses go into a second jug. 6/4 is like that: one whole, and 2/4 past it.

prompt.hi: Ab 1/2 wale gap bhi bane hain. 0 se aise 4 gap chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?
prompt.en: Now there are gaps of 1/2 too. Moving 4 such gaps from 0, which number on the line do you reach?

reask.hi: 1/2 wale 4 gap 0 se chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?
reask.en: Moving 4 gaps of 1/2 from 0, which number on the line do you reach?

why.hi: 4/2 matlab 1/2 ke 4 gap, aur har 2 gap se ek poora banta hai, toh 4/2 = 2
why.en: 4/2 is 4 gaps of 1/2, and every 2 gaps make one whole, so 4/2 = 2

whyShort.hi: do gap ek poora hain, toh 4 gap 2 poore
whyShort.en: two gaps make a whole, so 4 gaps are 2

whyAlt.hi: 1 par tum pehle 2 aadhe gap chalkar hi pahunch gaye the; 4 gap mein se baaki gap bhi chalne hain, aur woh bhi utni hi door aur le jaate hain
whyAlt.en: you already reached 1 after the first 2 half-gaps; the rest of the 4 gaps still have to be walked, and they take you just as far again

simpler.hi: Do aadhe milkar ek poora banate hain. 1/2 wale gaps ko do-do karke gino.
simpler.en: Two halves make one whole. Count the gaps of 1/2 in twos.

viewCaption.hi: Ab line ki dono taraf pattiyan hain: ek taraf 6/4 tak rang bhara hai, aur doosri taraf ki har patti sirf do bade gaps mein kati hai. Doosri taraf ki patti ke gaps 0 se ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: Now there are strips on both sides of the line: one side is coloured up to 6/4, and each strip on the other side is cut into just two big gaps. Look at the other side's gaps one by one from 0.

simpler.hi: Chaar chauthai milkar ek poora banta hai. Chhe chauthai mein ek poora bhi hai, aur do chauthai usse aage.
simpler.en: Four quarters make one whole. Six quarters hold one whole, and two quarters more beyond it.

explain.convey: thirds on a line to 3: every 3 gaps = one whole → 3/3 = 1; group the gaps in threes to find which wholes a fraction has passed; top above 3 → past 1

viewCaption.hi: Line ab teen poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti teen barabar gaps mein. Pehli patti rangi hai aur uske sire par 3/3 = 1 likha hai: har patti ek poora hai.
viewCaption.en: The line is now three whole strips end to end, each in three equal gaps. The first strip is coloured and at its end it reads 3/3 = 1: each strip is one whole.

point.hi: Yeh line 0 se 3 tak hai, har poore ke 3 barabar gaps. Teen gaps chalo toh 1 aata hai, 3/3 = 1. Teen-teen gaps ka har group ek poora hai.
point.en: This line runs from 0 to 3, each whole in 3 equal gaps. Walk three gaps and you reach 1, 3/3 = 1. Each group of three gaps is one whole.

pointAlt.hi: Laddu ginte waqt hum unhe teen-teen ke group mein rakhte hain. Is line ke gaps bhi waise hi gino: har 3 gaps ka group ek poora hai, isliye pehle group ke end par 1 hai.
pointAlt.en: When counting laddoos we put them in groups of three. Count this line's gaps the same way: each group of 3 gaps is one whole, so 1 is at the end of the first group.

prompt.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakho. Har group mein theek teen gap hon, toh kitne group bante hain?
prompt.en: Put the 7 gaps of 7/3 in threes. If each group has exactly three gaps, how many groups do you get?

reask.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps mein theek teen-teen gaps wale kitne group bante hain?
reask.en: How many groups of exactly three gaps are in the 7 gaps of 7/3?

why.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps mein teen-teen gaps ke 2 group bante hain, 6/3 = 2, aur 1 gap bachta hai
why.en: 7/3 has 7 gaps: 2 groups of three gaps, 6/3 = 2, and 1 gap left over

whyShort.hi: teen-teen ke 2 group, aur 1 gap bachta hai
whyShort.en: 2 groups of three, and 1 gap left over

whyAlt.hi: laddu ki tarah gino: har baar poore teen gap uthao, aur dekho kitni baar poore teen uth paate hain
whyAlt.en: count them like laddoos: each time pick up a full three gaps, and see how many times a full three can be picked up

simpler.hi: Saat gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakhte jao. Jo gap akela bach jaaye, woh group nahi banata.
simpler.en: Keep putting the seven gaps into groups of three. A gap left on its own does not make a group.

simpler.hi: Teen gap chalo toh 1 aata hai, teen aur chalo toh agla poora number. Har poora number pichhle se teen gap aage hai.
simpler.en: Move three gaps and you reach 1; three more and you reach the next whole number. Each whole number is three gaps past the one before.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 2 tak hai, barabar gaps mein kati hui. Is par 7/4 ka mark dhoondhna hai.
problem.en: A number line goes from 0 to 2, cut into equal gaps. We need to find the mark for 7/4 on it.

problemAlt.hi: 7/4 ke liye 0 se 1/4 wale 7 gap chalne hain. Dekhenge ki in 7 mein se kitne gap ek poora bharte hain, aur kitne uske aage jaate hain.
problemAlt.en: For 7/4 we walk 7 gaps of 1/4 from 0. We'll see how many of the 7 fill one whole, and how many go beyond it.

simpler.hi: Roti se socho: 7/4 matlab ek jaise 7 hisse. Pehle dekhenge ki kitne hisson se ek poori roti banti hai, phir bache hue hisse.
simpler.en: Think of roti: 7/4 means 7 same-size pieces. First we'll see how many pieces make one whole roti, then the pieces left over.

givens.hi: 7/4 mein neeche wala number 4, upar wala number 7
givens.en: 7/4 has bottom number 4 and top number 7

prompt.hi: 7/4 ke 7 gap 0 se chalo: 1 tak kitne gap lagte hain?
prompt.en: Walk the 7 gaps of 7/4 from 0: how many reach 1?

hindi.hi: 7/4 matlab 0 se 7 chhote hisse. Ek poora, yaani 1, banne ke liye unmein se kitne chahiye?
hindi.en: 7/4 means 7 small pieces from 0. How many of them are needed to make one whole, that is 1?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 tak kitne gap lagte hain?
reask.en: How many gaps from 0 to 1?

do.hi: 7 gaps mein se ek poore ke gap alag karo
do.en: Take out of the 7 gaps the ones that make one whole

why.hi: ek poore mein 4 gap hain, toh 4/4 = 1
why.en: one whole has 4 gaps, so 4/4 = 1

told.hi: Ek poore mein 4 gap hain, 4/4 = 1. Toh 7 mein se pehle 4 gap 1 tak le jaate hain.
told.en: One whole has 4 gaps, 4/4 = 1. So of the 7, the first 4 gaps take us to 1.

simpler.hi: Line par 0 se 1 tak ke gap gino; utne gap milkar ek poora banate hain.
simpler.en: Count the gaps on the line from 0 to 1; that many together make one whole.

why.hi: 7/4 ke saare 7 gap 0 se gine jaate hain
why.en: all 7 gaps of 7/4 are counted from 0

told.hi: Baaki gap 1 ke aage chalte hain, aur 7/4 ka mark 1 aur 2 ke beech aata hai.
told.en: The other gaps are walked past 1, and the mark for 7/4 comes between 1 and 2.

simpler.hi: 1 par ruk mat jao: 7 gap poore hone tak aage chalna hai.
simpler.en: Don't stop at 1: keep going until all 7 gaps are walked.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: 7/4 ko ek poore aur ek fraction mein kaise bologe?
prompt.en: Your turn: how do you say 7/4 as one whole and a fraction?

reask.hi: 7/4 ko ek poore aur ek fraction mein bolo: kya banega?
reask.en: Say 7/4 as one whole and a fraction: what does it come to?

why.hi: 4 gap ek poora, 1 ke aage 3 gap yaani 3/4; toh 7/4 = 1 aur 3/4, likhte hain 1 3/4
why.en: 4 gaps make a whole, 3 past 1 are 3/4; so 7/4 = 1 and 3/4, written 1 3/4

whyAlt.hi: Tumne sirf 1 ke aage wale gap gine. 1 tak ke 4 gap bhi 7/4 mein hain, aur woh ek poora banate hain; use bhi jawab mein bolo.
whyAlt.en: You counted only the gaps past 1. The 4 gaps up to 1 are in 7/4 too, and they make one whole; say that in the answer as well.

simpler.hi: 1 tak ke gap milkar ek poora hain. Ab 1 ke aage wale gaps ko bhi fraction mein bolo.
simpler.en: The gaps up to 1 make one whole. Now say the gaps past 1 as a fraction too.

answer.hi: 7/4 = 1 aur 3/4, yaani ek poora aur teen chauthai
answer.en: 7/4 = 1 and 3/4, that is one whole and three quarters

why.hi: 1 tak ke 4 gap ek poora bante hain, aur 1 ke aage ke 3 gap 3/4 hain
why.en: the 4 gaps up to 1 make one whole, and the 3 gaps past 1 are 3/4

viewCaption.hi: Yahan 0 se 2 tak ki line poori pattiyon mein hai, ek ke baad ek, har patti barabar gaps mein. Har patti ka sira ek poora number hai, aur 7/4 ki jagah inhi gaps mein dhoondhni hai.
viewCaption.en: Here the line from 0 to 2 is whole strips end to end, each strip in equal gaps. The end of each strip is a whole number, and the place of 7/4 is to be found among these gaps.

prompt.hi: Ek line lo, 0 se 3 tak, har poora 3 barabar gaps mein. 5/3 kaun se do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
prompt.en: Take a line from 0 to 3, each whole in 3 equal gaps. Between which two whole numbers is 5/3?

hindi.hi: 0 se 3 tak ki line par har poore mein 3 gap hain. 5/3 tak chalkar tum kin do poore numbers ke beech rukoge?
hindi.en: On a line from 0 to 3, every whole has 3 gaps. Walking to 5/3, between which two whole numbers do you stop?

reask.hi: 5/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech hai?
reask.en: Between which two whole numbers is 5/3?

did.hi: teen-teen gaps ke group banakar 5/3 ki jagah dhoondhi
did.en: grouped the gaps in threes to find where 5/3 sits

accept: 1 aur 2 ke beech mein aata hai
ek aur do ke beech mein

viewCaption.hi: Line ab poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti teen barabar gaps mein. 0 se gaps gino: har patti ke sire par ek poora number aata hai.
viewCaption.en: The line is now whole strips end to end, each in three equal gaps. Count the gaps from 0: at the end of each strip comes a whole number.

why.hi: 3/3 = 1 aur 6/3 = 2, aur 5/3 dono ke beech hai
why.en: 3/3 = 1 and 6/3 = 2, and 5/3 sits between them

whyShort.hi: 5/3, 3/3 aur 6/3 ke beech hai
whyShort.en: 5/3 sits between 3/3 and 6/3

whyAlt.hi: 0 aur 1 ke beech tab hota jab 5/3 ke gap 3 se kam hote; par 3 gap mein hi 1 aa jaata hai, aur 5 gap usse aage jaate hain
whyAlt.en: between 0 and 1 would be right only if 5/3 had fewer than 3 gaps; but 3 gaps already reach 1, and 5 gaps go past it

answerViewCaption.hi: Yahan 0 se 5/3 tak ke gaps rangin hain: pehli patti poori, yaani 1, aur agli patti ke do gaps. Isliye 5/3, 1 aur 2 ke beech hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Here the gaps from 0 to 5/3 are coloured: the first strip in full, that is 1, and two gaps of the next strip. So 5/3 is between 1 and 2.

simpler.hi: Line par 1 aur 2 dekho, aur gino ki 0 se har ek tak kitne gap hain. Phir 5/3 ke gap gino.
simpler.en: Look at 1 and 2 on the line, and count how many gaps there are from 0 to each. Then count the gaps of 5/3.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 2 tak. 1/6 ke 11 gap chalo, ya 1/12 ke 11 gap. 0 se zyada door kaun gaya: 11/6 ya 11/12?
prompt.en: A line from 0 to 2. Move 11 gaps of 1/6, or 11 gaps of 1/12. Which goes further from 0: 11/6 or 11/12?

hindi.hi: Do bachche 0 se 2 tak ki line par chale, aur dono ne 11 gap chale: ek ka har gap 1/6 ka, doosre ka 1/12 ka. 11/6 aur 11/12 mein se kaun aage nikla?
hindi.en: Two children walked a line from 0 to 2, and both walked 11 gaps: one child's every gap was 1/6, the other's 1/12. Of 11/6 and 11/12, which got further?

reask.hi: Kaun zyada door gaya: 11/6 ya 11/12?
reask.en: Which went further: 11/6 or 11/12?

did.hi: 1/6 aur 1/12 ke 11-11 gap chalkar dekha kaun aage gaya
did.en: walked 11 gaps of 1/6 and of 1/12 to compare them

viewCaption.hi: Ab line ki dono taraf pattiyan hain, dono 0 se shuru: ek taraf ki har patti chhe gaps mein, doosri taraf ki barah chhote gaps mein. Dono taraf patti ki lambai ek jaisi hai.
viewCaption.en: Now there are strips on both sides of the line, both starting at 0: each strip on one side is in six gaps, each on the other side in twelve smaller gaps. The strips are the same length on both sides.

why.hi: 1/6 ka gap 1/12 wale se do guna hai, toh 11/6, yaani 1 aur 5/6, 11/12 se aage hai
why.en: a 1/6 gap is twice a 1/12 one, so 11/6, that is 1 and 5/6, is past 11/12

whyShort.hi: 1/6 ka gap do guna, toh 11/6 aage
whyShort.en: a 1/6 gap is twice as long; 11/6 is further

whyAlt.hi: 12 ko bada number dekhkar chuna hai; par dono mein 11 hi gap hain, toh faisla is baat se hoga ki kiska ek gap lamba hai
whyAlt.en: you chose by 12 being the bigger number; but both have 11 gaps, so it comes down to whose one gap is longer

answerViewCaption.hi: Ek taraf 11/6 tak rang pehli patti ke paar, agli patti mein jaata hai; doosri taraf 11/12 tak rang pehli patti mein hi ruk jaata hai. Isliye 11/6 zyada door hai.
answerViewCaption.en: On one side the colour up to 11/6 goes past the first strip into the next; on the other side the colour up to 11/12 stops inside the first strip. So 11/6 is further.

simpler.hi: Gap dono taraf 11 hain. Lamba gap kaunsa hai, 1/6 wala ya 1/12 wala, bas yeh socho.
simpler.en: 11 gaps on each side. Just think which gap is longer, the 1/6 one or the 1/12 one.

prompt.hi: Is line par 0, 1, 2 aur 3 likhe hain, aur har do poore numbers ke beech 5 barabar gaps hain. 2 ke baad doosra mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: This line has 0, 1, 2 and 3 written on it, with 5 equal gaps between each pair of whole numbers. What fraction is the 2nd mark after 2?

hindi.hi: 0 se 1, 1 se 2 aur 2 se 3 tak, har hissa 5 gap mein bata hai. 2 se do mark aage wali jagah ka fraction kya hai?
hindi.en: From 0 to 1, 1 to 2 and 2 to 3, each stretch is split into 5 gaps. What fraction is the place two marks past 2?

reask.hi: 2 ke baad doosra mark kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: Which fraction is the second mark after 2?

did.hi: 0 se gaps ginkar 2 ke baad doosre mark ka naam rakha
did.en: counted the gaps from 0 and named the second mark after 2

why.hi: Tumne 2 ke baad pehle mark ka naam bataya. 2 se do gap aage jao, phir 0 se saare gap gino.
why.en: You named the first mark after 2. Go two gaps on from 2, then count all the gaps from 0.

viewCaption.hi: Line ab teen poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti paanch barabar gaps mein. Sawaal wale mark tak ke gaps rangin hain; 0 se rangin gaps gino.
viewCaption.en: The line is now three whole strips end to end, each in five equal gaps. The gaps up to the question mark are coloured; count the coloured gaps from 0.

why.hi: har 5 gaps se ek poora, toh 2 tak 10 gaps; 2 aur chalo toh 12/5, yaani 2 aur 2/5
why.en: every 5 gaps make one whole, so 2 is 10 gaps; 2 more make 12/5, that is 2 and 2/5

whyShort.hi: 2 tak 10 gaps, aur 2 gap aage: 12/5
whyShort.en: 10 gaps reach 2, and 2 more make 12/5

whyAlt.hi: 2/5 toh 1 se bhi pehle aata hai, jabki yeh mark 2 ke baad hai; 0 se 2 tak ke gaps bhi upar wale number mein judte hain
whyAlt.en: 2/5 comes even before 1, while this mark is after 2; the gaps from 0 to 2 also go into the top number

answerViewCaption.hi: Do poori pattiyan rangi hain, yaani 10 gaps, aur teesri patti ke 2 gaps aur. 0 se kul 12 gaps, har ek 1/5 ka, isliye 12/5.
answerViewCaption.en: Two whole strips are coloured, that is 10 gaps, and 2 more gaps of the third strip. 12 gaps from 0 in all, each 1/5, so 12/5.

simpler.hi: 0 se gaps gino: har poore ke gaps bhi, aur 2 ke aage wale bhi. Kul ginti fraction ka upar wala number hai.
simpler.en: Count the gaps from 0: the gaps of each whole, and the ones past 2 as well. The total count is the fraction's top number.

ladder.why: den 4 on 0 to 2, same den and line as e1, e2 and the worked example → 5/4 = one quarter past 1; smallest step beyond 1
den 3, no line given → decide before/after 1 from top vs bottom alone (4 > 3); moves the rule off the picture
den 2 inside a story: 1 km + half km → count in halves → 3/2; build the improper fraction from a real distance

remediation.move: eighth-gaps laid end to end on a 0-to-2 line, no squeezing: 8 gaps fill 0 to 1 exactly → 1 is full → the 9th gap must go past 1; then below, each whole in sixths: a runner runs 7 gaps → 7/6; a fraction is a length, and lengths can exceed one whole

say.hi: Yeh line 0 se 2 tak hai, har gap 1/8. 8 gap chalkar 1 aata hai, yaani 8/8; naunva gap 1 ke aage hai.
say.en: This line goes from 0 to 2, each gap 1/8. Walking 8 gaps brings us to 1, that is 8/8; the ninth gap is past 1.

simpler.hi: Ek bench par aath bachchon ki jagah ho aur nau bachche aayein, toh naunve ko doosri bench par baithna padta hai. Naunva gap bhi aise hi 1 ke aage jaata hai.
simpler.en: If a bench has room for eight children and nine come, the ninth has to sit on a second bench. The ninth gap goes past 1 the same way.

sayAlt.hi: 1 se peeche ki taraf dekho: 1 par 8/8 hai, aur usse ek gap peeche 7/8. Ginti 8 se jitni aage badhti hai, gap utne hi 1 ke paar jaate hain, jaise naunva gap 9/8 par.
sayAlt.en: Look back from 1: 8/8 is at 1, and one gap back is 7/8. However far the count goes past 8, that many gaps go past 1, like the ninth gap at 9/8.

viewCaption.hi: Line ab do poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti aath barabar gaps mein. Pehli patti poori rangi hai aur uske sire par 8/8 = 1 likha hai; agla gap doosri patti mein hai.
viewCaption.en: The line is now two whole strips end to end, each in eight equal gaps. The first strip is coloured in full and its end reads 8/8 = 1; the next gap is in the second strip.
